 Kaya Scodelario’s Rerun at Netflix’s ‘The Gentlemen’ Event
 Posted by Catherine Kallon 
 Kaya Scodelario attended Netflix’s The Gentlemen FYC event at the Netflix Tudum Theater in Los Angeles over the weekend, making a stylish appearance as the series continues starts its awards campaign.
 Kevin Winter/Getty Images) 
 I’m sure you instantly recognised her Simkhai Resort 2027 strapless fringed dress, because we only just saw it on Stella Hanan at last week’s CFDA Fashion Awards.
 And frankly, I’m more than happy to see it again. The fitted, pleated bodice and cascading fringe make this such a beautiful design. It’s one of those dresses that deserves a second outing, especially when both women wear it so well.
 I don’t know whether it’s the lighting, but Kaya’s dress appears noticeably whiter than Stella’s, which has a warmer ivory tone. Either way, the dress looks just as good the second time around.
 Jimmy Choo Inge sandals completed her look.
 Styled by Holly Gorst.
